name: Pangu
subtitle: The First Being
description: Balances Yin and Yang to empower his abilities and crush enemies, especially in the early game.
lore: A primordial being older even than Tian’s other gods, Pangu shaped much of reality, and his body itself forms many of the realm’s earth and mountains. Since the Shattering, a portion of him has awakened and manifested, providing aid and advice to gods of Order. Should he awaken in his entirety, the results to Tian could be nothing short of apocalyptic.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when attacking enemies under [Debuff].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Strong Hit Chance Multiplier +15%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, Strong Hit DMG Multiplier +30%
Awaken the ability: Heaven and Earth
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%
Awaken the ability: Yin and Yang

skills.name: Heaven and Earth
skills.description: Place [mechanic:acc-up-ii] on this hero for 2 turns then attack all enemies. If this hero has more INIT than SPD, place [mechanic:def-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns and increase this hero’s SPD by 50. Otherwise, place [mechanic:init-down-ii] on each target hit for 2 turns and decrease this hero’s SPD by 50.
skills.awakening_bonus: If this hero has more INIT than SPD, place [ATK Down II] otherwise place a random [Lock] on each target for 2 turns.

skills.name: World Splitter
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. If this hero has more INIT than SPD, increase their RES by 1%. Otherwise, increase DEF by 1%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also, Increase ACC by 1% when INIT is more than SPD and increase ATK by 1% when SPD is more than INIT.

skills.name: Yin and Yang
skills.description: Place [mechanic:res-up-ii] on this hero for 2 turns then attack all enemies. If this hero has more SPD than INIT, then place [mechanic:drain-ii] on each target for 2 turns and increase this hero’s INIT by 50. Otherwise, place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] on each target hit for 2 turns and decrease this hero’s INIT by 50.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also Increase this hero’s HP by 10% (stacking up to 5 times).

skills.name: Balance of Force
skills.description: If this hero has more INIT than SPD, attacks steal 10% turn meter from the target. Otherwise, they steal 10% Divinity from the target.

imprint_passive: If this hero has more INIT than SPD, attacks steal 5% turn meter from the target. Otherwise, they steal 5% Divinity from the target.
